evals.prompt: Connect this existing React repository to my agent workflow. Keep the setup quick, preserve its AGENTS.md, and add only clearly relevant skills.
evals.expected_output: The project is connected through the Project Control Center, the existing AGENTS.md content is preserved, and only a small evidence-based skill set is selected.

evals.prompt: Initialize a new Python project folder with global and local memory and a basic AGENTS.md. I only have a one-sentence project description so far.
evals.expected_output: A useful first-pass structure is created from templates/base-project/AGENTS.md, with discovered project context replacing placeholders and reusable template guidance retained, without requiring a deep project analysis or inventing unknown commands and constraints.

evals.prompt: Refresh the agent workflow in this already configured repository after I changed its purpose. Do not overwrite its local notes or local skills.
evals.expected_output: The managed AGENTS.md context is refreshed while existing local memory, local skills, and user-authored instructions remain intact.
